findings.skill_statement: The repeat-control self-test writes its scratch under /tmp. At C* tools/repeat-control.py:597 creates it with tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="tameshi-r12-repeat-control-selftest.", dir=tempfile.gettempdir()), so the base is $TMPDIR when that is writable and /tmp only as the fallback; the same fix pass that patched the tool (218bc6b) moved the sibling env-diff registry cell to `$TMPDIR`, leaving this cell naming a location the tool does not use under the directive-mandated TMPDIR.

The bash witness-study self-test private root is under /tmp. At C* tools/bash-witness-study.py:1240-1241 creates it with tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="bash-witness-selftest-private.", dir=tempfile.gettempdir()), so the base is $TMPDIR when that is writable; the cell states a fixed /tmp base for a write scope that follows TMPDIR.
